ownerBindings.renderingToolchain: mature external tools selected per Study
ownerBindings.physicalExecution: services/runtime when exact execution evidence is needed

stopRules: Do not reopen science to repair a carrier-only defect unless contradictory evidence appears.
Do not treat deterministic rendering as venue conformance.
Do not treat machine layout PASS as Human perceptual signoff.
Do not freeze reviewer artifact bytes before carrier QA has closed.
Venue rules stay external-authority-bound and dated; Artifact interprets contracts but does not own policy.

studyOverlay.role: Study-local additions such as identity-leak patterns, exact figure/caption counts, required supplements, and claim/artifact consistency bindings.
